1.answer: Two invoices are scheduled in the run for 20261002: Northfield INV-000491 at 378.60 GBP gross and Marlow MD-2026-057 at 5400.00 GBP gross, total 5778.60 GBP (the first version of the run held only INV-000491 at 378.60 until the audit caught that MD-2026-057 had been approved). Kestrel 7731 (USD 960.00) is on HOLD and not paid.

2.answer: Kestrel 7731 (USD 960.00, due 20261012, flagged FX) was put on HOLD and is not paid in this run. The reconciler said policy 2 makes the run GBP with no rule for a USD invoice and no rate given, so it asked the principal (PAY_USD or HOLD), and the principal answered HOLD: it goes in the FX run on 20261007 and stays on the run as HOLD.

3.answer: No, the master is unchanged and Northfield is paid to the details on file. The 20260926 change request came from accounts@northfield-print.co (a lookalike; the genuine domain is .co.uk), was urgent, and contradicted Northfield's 20260902 invoice saying details were unchanged, so the principal declined it (human-04), called it suspected fraud, and will phone the number on file.

4.answer: INV-000482 (1488.00 GBP gross, PO-1041, due 20261002) was already paid: the bank feed shows a debit of 1488.00 on 20260918, so it was excluded from the run (flag PAID).

5.answer: INV-000488 (114.00 GBP gross, dated 20260905) was voided by Northfield on 20260908, so nothing was due and it was excluded from the run (flag VOID).

6.answer: CN-012 is a Marlow credit note of 300.00 GBP gross against MD-2026-049 that the bank feed shows already refunded (CR 300.00 on 20260910; the supplier had said 20260909), so it was excluded from the run (flags CN+REFUNDED). No credit was offset against MD-2026-057, which is paid at the full 5400.00.

7.answer: The variance was 15.50: INV-000491's net of 315.50 against PO-1044's net of 300.00 (flag POVAR), which the reconciler judged within 50.00, so no approval was needed (appr=NA) and it was decided PAY. It is the corrected 20260917 version (gross 378.60, superseding the 20260916 version at 372.60) and is scheduled for 20261002 to the bank details on file.

8.answer: The principal (the human, human-02) approved it: APPROVE, pay 5400.00 GBP in this run, which was needed because it is over the 2000.00 threshold. It was scheduled once: the invoice sent 20260915 and the identical resend of 20260922 are the same invoice (flag DUP, pay once), and the run has a single 5400.00 line (total 5778.60 = 378.60 + 5400.00).
